date.as_written: samvat 491 bhādrapadaśuklatṛtī〇yāyāṃ tithau hastanakṣatre śubhayoge bṛhaspativāsare

notes: The catalogue records King Jayārjunadeva and Scribe Gomendracandra (known from Petech's reading of this colophon), but both names fall directly inside lacunae in the quoted transcript ('rājādhirājaparameśva⁅ra⁆/// -nāṃ' and 'śrīyokhācchevi〇hārādhivāsi/// -rthahetunā svahastena likhitam'). 'ṭoḍalamalla' and 'vīranārāyaṇa' are royal virudas. Since the names are not preserved in the provided colophon text, no persons are extracted.
